title: An Se-young Claims 11th Title at Korea Open 2026
indian_angle: An Se-young's continued dominance sets a high benchmark for Indian shuttlers aiming for international success.
summary: South Korea's An Se-young defeated Japan's Akane Yamaguchi in the Korea Open 2026 final, securing her 11th title of the year.

title: An Se-young Extends Unbeaten Run with Korea Open Victory
indian_angle: The consistent performance of top international players like An Se-young provides valuable insights for Indian coaches and players.
summary: An Se-young beat Akane Yamaguchi 21-12, 15-21, 21-16 in the Korea Open final, extending her unbeaten streak since March.

title: An Se-young Equals All-Time Calendar Year Title Record
indian_angle: An Se-young's record-equalling achievement underscores the level of dedication and skill required to dominate the global badminton circuit, inspiring Indian talent.
summary: Korea's badminton superstar An Se-young has won her 11th title of 2026, equalling the all-time calendar year record.
